name: Order Payment Status Derived
description: Order paymentStatus must be derived/reconciled from authoritative payment, capture and refund facts rather than freely edited by a user interface.
purpose: Order paymentStatus must be derived/reconciled from authoritative payment, capture and refund facts rather than freely edited by a user interface.

requirements.description: Order paymentStatus must be derived/reconciled from authoritative payment, capture and refund facts rather than freely edited by a user interface.
The rule must be evaluated from authoritative server-side state and must not trust browser-calculated or provider-reported state without required validation/reconciliation.

failure.notes: Phase 12 defines the domain error identifier. HTTP mapping and response envelopes are reserved for Phase 18.

relationships.description: This rule constrains commerce.order operations or state.
This rule constrains commerce.payment operations or state.
This rule constrains commerce.paymentCapture operations or state.
This rule constrains commerce.refund operations or state.

valid: An operation involving commerce.order, commerce.payment satisfies the rule before authoritative state is committed.
invalid: An implementation bypasses commerce.rule.orderPaymentStatusDerived and commits a conflicting or unverifiable state.

implementationNotes: Enforce at the server-side commerce domain boundary.
Use canonical Phase 11 schemas as the data model; do not create shadow transaction models.
If provider behavior differs, translate through an adapter and reconcile to canonical NEXT F state.
